svg.title: Planting widths · Main street
svg.desc: Planting strips at one scale: tree strip at least 3 metres; main street tree strip 3.5; low shrubs 2.5; lawn or ground cover 2 metres. Source claims: ground. Tree height 5 m / crown 3 m, shrub height 0.6 m / crown 0.9 m, person 1.75 m and low ground-cover relief are illustration assumptions, not species or clearance specifications. Decorative 0.24 m bases are not specified soil depths or storage volumes.
